invariants.name: Dropping the brand token never promotes a different-brand row to confident
A one-edit typo on a rare token yields the same top entity
An unexplained rare token yields none or ambiguous, never confident
The cousin never outranks its target
All-zero macros outside beverage/water/sweetener categories are rejected
Serper-only data is never confident and never auto-fills a barcode
invariants.note: P2 checks search confidence only; barcode autofill is P4.

invariants.name: Barcodes with a bad checksum make no network call
invariants.note: Count comes from scripts/traceBarcodeMismatch.js, which invokes the live /api/food/barcode handler with axios stubbed.

invariants.name: Consensus never merges rows from different clusters
